method: empirical — each edge case executed, not reasoned about

k_above_cap_200.result: capped at 200 -> invalid_k fallback; k>n_items can never reach FAISS

missing_keys_in_pickle.result: clean load_error, but had empty-fallback gap

x_y_factor_dim_mismatch.result: passed startup ready=True, only surfaced per-request

fixes_applied.break: popularity loaded inside the model-load try -> any c2_als.pkl failure left pop_top unset -> index_load_failure returned 0 items, breaking the 0%-empty guarantee.
fixes_applied.fix: load popularity INDEPENDENTLY of (and before) the model; init pop_top/_head/_pop_pct/b2c as safe defaults; not-ready path serves _pop_fallback(k).
fixes_applied.verified: corrupt pickle -> ready=False but recommend returns 5 popularity items (source=popularity), not 0.

fixes_applied.break: startup assert exact.d==dim is tautological (index built from Y); a real X/Y factor-dim mismatch passed startup as healthy and only surfaced per-request.
fixes_applied.fix: added assert X.shape[1]==Y.shape[1] and assert len(i_uniq)==n_items BEFORE building the index.
fixes_applied.verified: X(8)/Y(4) pickle -> ready=False with load_error 'X/Y factor-dim mismatch: X=8 Y=4'; degrades to popularity.

regression_check: real c2 service: ready=True; warm k=20 -> 20; unknown -> 20; k=99999 -> 20. No regression.
cloud_run_verdict: 512MB fits ALS-only service; 1GB if semantic lane co-loaded. Set min-instances>=1 and persist FAISS index to avoid rebuild on cold start.
documented_limitations: BM25 ~63ms/query is a pure-Python rank_bm25 artifact; production = bm25s/Lucene/Elasticsearch (sub-ms).
Single-process / GIL-bound concurrency; multi-worker for real throughput.
In-memory metrics reset on restart; ship to Prometheus.
FAISS index rebuilt at startup (not persisted).
Degraded fallback depends on train.csv presence; if model AND train.csv both unreadable, fallback is empty (logged).
net: Request-path failure modes already graceful; stress test found and FIXED two load-path gaps that gave false confidence; serving layer is deployment-sane within documented limitations.
